turns.replyText:
Can I pay in installments or split payment?

You may be able to, depending on what shows up for you at checkout.

Here’s how it works:

• At checkout, you might see installment options from third-party providers like Shop Pay Installments, Affirm, Klarna, etc. If you see one of these, you can select it and apply for paying over time. Eligibility and terms are set entirely by that provider, not by us.

• We don’t control or adjust: • Your installment schedule • Which card or bank account is used • How many payments you have or when they’re due

• If by “split payment” you mean using two different cards directly on our site for one order, that isn’t something we can set up. The only way to break up payments is through an installment provider if it’s offered to you at checkout.

If you end up using installments and later need to change your card, reschedule a payment, or ask about fees, you’ll want to contact that installment provider directly, using the info in their confirmation email.
